name: budget_vs_actuals
description: Compare actuals to the plan/budget baseline for any P&L line, cost center, or business unit. The baseline is whichever plan version the organization has locked as its budget (a frozen budget table, or a designated version inside a versioned planning fact). Flags material variances automatically, generates written commentary for each flagged line, and supports monthly close and quarterly close workflows. Triggers: budget vs actuals, BvA, plan vs actuals, how did we do vs budget, variance to plan, are we on budget, monthly close, quarterly close, opex vs budget, expense variance, headcount vs budget, are we over budget, spending vs plan.
